ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Sweatbook uses the microphone to record voice notes about your hands, for your Instagram stories and for hand videos.
ios.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Sweatbook uses Face ID to unlock the app, if you turn on the lock in Settings.
ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Sweatbook uses the camera to photograph receipts and tax forms and to record your face for hand videos.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Sweatbook uses your photos so you can attach tax receipts and forms to your sessions.
